Sergio / Vanessa,

Quick heads up from the warehouse in Amsterdam: your crate for Global Events Ltd arrived at AMS bonded facility this morning but the local customs team is holding it because the commercial invoice on file does not show a VAT ID or the supplier VAT reference. The warehouse needs one of the following to release: a corrected commercial invoice with VAT number, or a pro-forma invoice that includes VAT registration and value breakdown.

We have the bill of lading and packing list attached but the commercial_invoice_98765.pdf seems to be missing the VAT line. Can you confirm if Redwood has a VAT registration to include, or if Global Events provided a vendor VAT for import? If neither exists, customs is requesting proof of fiscal representation or payment arrangement.

Warehouse contact: Amsterdam Bonded Warehouse <ams-ops@bonded-ams.nl> (handling code HLD-2026-98765)
Attachments: bill_of_lading_98765.pdf, commercial_invoice_98765.pdf
